title: How the NBI foiled an alleged school shooting plot in Ilocos Norte
summary: The foiled shooting plot in Ilocos Norte comes amid growing concerns over school safety. This year alone, three deadly school shootings occurred between June and September 2026.

blocks.text: Trigger warning: Mentions of shooting, killing, and death
The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) foiled an alleged school shooting plot involving three minors in Batac, Ilocos Norte, NBI Director Melvin Matibag revealed recently.
The planned attack was reportedly scheduled for December 16, 2026 — coinciding with the start of Simbang Gabi or the dawn Masses associated with Christmas.
One of the minors had reportedly experienced bullying since Grade 7 and was influenced by video of the 1999 Columbine High School shooting in the United States.
“Nakakuha kami ng report from our counterparts abroad sa NBI. May isang group na nakita sila nag-uusap. Immediately we deployed ang task force natin,” Matibag said in an interview with ABS-CBN News.
(We received a report from our counterparts abroad. They discovered a group of individuals discussing [the planned attack]. We immediately deployed our task force.)
On November 17, the NBI disclosed that three 16-year-old students were suspected of planning a shooting attack against their schoolmates in Batac, Ilocos Norte.
According to Matibag, one of the students allegedly intended to target students who, he claimed, had bullied him since the 7th Grade.

During interviews with investigators, he identified several individuals whom he accused of bullying.According to a South China Morning Post report, the teenager reportedly recruited two other students to participate in the plan. The two, however, thought that the proposed attack was a joke.

The plot came to the attention of Philippine authorities after the US Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) discovered an online group chat. The suspected students allegedly discussed the planned attack in their conversation.

Following the tip, the NBI then deployed its Task Force on National Violent Extremism to investigate the report, as Matibag explained. Authorities subsequently conducted operations in Batac on November 15 and 16, leading to the three teenagers being taken under the bureau’s custody.
Matibag confirmed that the statements obtained from the minors during interviews were consistent with the information given by the FBI.

Aside from the reported bullying, investigators identified a possible influence in the planned attack. According to Matibag, the Grade 9 student who initiated the plot had watched videos of the 1999 Columbine High School shooting in the US.
“Napanood niya ang video ng Columbine, which encouraged him to do the same,” Matibag told reporters.
(He watched a video of the Columbine [shooting], which encouraged him to do the same.)

The Columbine High School shooting occurred on April 20, 1999, in Colorado. During the attack, two students opened fire and killed 12 students and one teacher. Around two dozen others were injured before the attackers took their own lives.
At that time, Columbine received extensive media coverage and prompted widespread concerns about school safety.

The shooting became a reference point for subsequent attacks. Research examining school shootings found that some perpetrators had studied the Columbine incident or explicitly referred to it when planning their own attacks.
The foiled shooting plot in Ilocos Norte comes amid growing concerns over school safety. This year alone, three deadly school shootings occurred in the Philippines between June and September 2026.

items: On June 22, three students were killed at San Jose National High School in Tacloban, Leyte. Two minors aged 14 and 15 were identified as suspects in the attack.
Another shooting happened on August 18 at Ateneo de Zamboanga University. A Grade 9 student shot and killed a Grade 10 student before taking his own life.
On September 18, shooting at Banga National High School in South Cotabato left three students dead. Among those killed was the 16-year-old suspected gunman.

blocks.text: Apart from these incidents, authorities have recorded several school shooting threats and suspected plots. Between June 16 and August 19, the Philippine National Police recorded 12 shooting threats involving schools nationwide.
Interior Secretary Juanito Victor “Jonvic” Remulla said in October that law enforcement officials had also thwarted 53 other suspected shooting plots in South Cotabato. – Rena Eñano/Rappler.com
Rena Eñano, a Rappler intern, is a senior literature student from Ateneo de Manila University.
